description: Order-book snapshot for one coin's perpetuals: best bid/ask, spread in bps, top-of-book depth (USD) per side, bid/ask depth imbalance, and the cost vs mid of $10k and $100k market orders against the visible levels. Positive imbalance means more bid depth. Single-venue by nature — Hyperliquid, falling back to Bybit for coins it doesn't list; the response names the venue that answered and how far its visible book reaches.
name: flow_orderbook

fillCosts.description: Cost vs mid of a market order of each size against the visible levels

buyBps.description: Average buy fill vs mid in bps; absent when the visible asks can't fill the size

sellBps.description: Average sell fill vs mid in bps (positive = cost); absent when the visible bids can't fill the size

imbalancePct.description: Signed bid-vs-ask depth skew in percentage points (positive = more bids)

spreadBps.description: Bid/ask spread, basis points of mid

visibleAskReachPct.description: Deepest returned ask vs mid, percent; nothing beyond is visible

visibleBidReachPct.description: Deepest returned bid vs mid, percent; nothing beyond is visible

title: Order Book Snapshot
